material_news_signals.headline: Cardinals place rookie Jeremiyah Love on IR due to high ankle sprain
material_news_signals.description: The Arizona Cardinals are placing rookie RB Jeremiyah Love on injured reserve due to a high ankle sprain, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport reported on Tuesday.
material_news_signals.body_text: jeremiyah love s rookie season has taken another turn for the worse the arizona cardinals have placed the running back on injured reserve due to a high ankle sprain that is expected to knock him out for four to five weeks nfl network insider ian rapoport reported on tuesday the no 3 overall pick had previously dealt with a different ankle sprain head coach mike lafleur said monday the cardinals also announced on tuesday that wide receiver kendrick bourne has been placed on ir love went down in the first quarter of sunday s comeback win over the dallas cowboys and did not return he d missed the previous two contests due to injury in six games the first rounder has generated 268 yards on 76 carries with one touchdown averaging 3 4 yards per tote the bulk of his production came in a 21 carry 90 yard performance in a week 3 loss to san francisco the cardinals used a top three pick on love in april believing he could add a dynamic game changing weapon to the backfield a la bijan robinson in atlanta or jahmyr gibbs in detroit love hasn t been healthy enough for most of the season to know for sure if he has that kind of sustainable upside arizona gave love a significant workload in his first preseason action handing it off 11 times and tossing him three passes the belief at the time was that getting reps early would prepare love for the regular season gauntlet instead he left that game with a nicked up ankle he hasn t seemed right since perhaps shutting the rb down for at least four games will allow him to come back fully healthy for the season s stretch run in the meantime tyler allgeier who sparked the cardinals comeback win over the cowboys figures to get the bulk of the totes fellow back bam knight currently is in the league s concussion protocol and veteran james conner remains on injured reserve evan hull is currently the healthy backup option for allgeier

tendinitis did not practice wednesday but coach kyle shanahan said the team hopes mccaffrey will be able to practice on a limited basis thursday mccaffrey whose leg went 34 dead 34 in the game against the atlanta falcons with what he first thought was a thigh injury sounded confident about his chances to face the raiders 34 i had no idea it was a hamstring injury 34 he said wednesday 34 sometimes against miami shanahan said evans 34 made a lot of progress 34 over the bye week while samuel seems a little further off the 49ers have been so depleted at wide receiver that they nearly traded for old friend jauan jennings shanahan indicated the team agreed to the framework of a trade with minnesota saying he arranged a facetime call with jennings through the vikings 34 we love jauan 34 facing a catastrophic quarterback situation two time mvp lamar jackson is heading for injured reserve after suffering an injury to his right thumb on the offense s first play from scrimmage in last week s game and backup tyler huntley is reportedly out for the season with turf toe which means undrafted rookie joe fagnano will be making his first career start on thursday in prime time the ravens are desperate for a win after three straight losses all to afc foes sank them to the bottom of the afc north the afc south leading jaguars made easy work of the stripped down colts at home last week can first year head coach jesse minter find a way to keep his squad afloat against a team eyeing a second straight division title let s consider a few key subplots for thursday night s tilt three must know storylines 1 are the jaguars inevitable no team has completed 50 of its regular season schedule entering week 9 and yet it already feels like the jaguars are a lock to host at least one playoff game in january they have a 95 playoff probability and a 90 chance of winning the afc south the highest division title odds of any team in the league per next gen stats their three wins by 20 plus points in 2026 are the most in the nfl also they have the easiest remaining strength of schedule of any team 416 that is where the challenge for liam coen now lies can he keep a heavily favored team from taking its foot off the gas when it s clearly in such an envious position it wasn t an issue last week against a colts squad that had traded away two of its best players in the days leading up to the game with jacksonville scoring 42 points in the first three quarters of a boat race trevor lawrence didn t even play in the fourth quarter yes the jags were well rested coming off a week 7 bye after their two week stay in london turning around and doing it again on the road with a condensed week of preparation is a different undertaking 2 is joe fagnano ready for his close up the undrafted rookie finds himself in a daunting situation ahead of his first career start with just a few days to prepare for the league s no 2 scoring defense there are already lists being compiled of quarterbacks the ravens should trade for so they don t have to play him he completed 10 of 21 passes for 91 yards with no touchdowns and one interception in his regular season debut a relief appearance for lamar jackson and tyler huntley against a much more forgiving defense in buffalo on sunday also fagnano is dealing with an injury of his own wearing a brace on his ankle during tuesday s practice the 25 year old has plenty of collegiate experience making 44 starts across seven seasons he posted a touchdown to interception ratio of 48 6 in his three seasons at uconn at 6 foot 3 230 pounds he has the size to play the position in the pros he has the potential to be an efficient distributor of the football but he s not going to flash any of the playmaking ability ravens fans are accustomed to seeing from jackson and to a lesser degree huntley managing a clean game would be an achievement by fagnano against the jaguars who are one of three teams with more interceptions than touchdown passes allowed this season it would help if he could get the ball to leading receiver zay flowers who didn t have a catch on five targets four by fagnano last week 3 can the ravens avoid the abyss while the jaguars playoff odds continue to surge the ravens have watched their chances fade away they ve gone from a 70 playoff probability to 20 in the span of four weeks so thursday would be a great time for jesse minter to pull a rabbit out of a hat he made his bones as a defensive coordinator and he still has elite talent to work with on that side of the ball including all pro safety kyle hamilton of course baltimore won t have any hope on thursday night if it can t get two time rushing king derrick henry going he has not reached 60 rushing yards in any game during the team s losing streak and now he ll face a defense that will undoubtedly be expecting a steady diet of henry carries with an undrafted rookie making his first career start under center the jaguars have the no 1 rushing defense in the nfl and allow a league low 3 4 yards per carry but that unit will be tested following the loss of run stuffing defensive tackle davon hamilton who suffered a season ending torn quadriceps muscle last week

material_news_signals.description: The Arizona Cardinals are placing rookie RB Jeremiyah Love on injured reserve due to a high ankle sprain, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport reported on Tuesday.
material_news_signals.body_text: jeremiyah love s rookie season has taken another turn for the worse the arizona cardinals have placed the running back on injured reserve due to a high ankle sprain that is expected to knock him out for four to five weeks nfl network insider ian rapoport reported on tuesday the no 3 overall pick had previously dealt with a different ankle sprain head coach mike lafleur said monday the cardinals also announced on tuesday that wide receiver kendrick bourne has been placed on ir love went down in the first quarter of sunday s comeback win over the dallas cowboys and did not return he d missed the previous two contests due to injury in six games the first rounder has generated 268 yards on 76 carries with one touchdown averaging 3 4 yards per tote the bulk of his production came in a 21 carry 90 yard performance in a week 3 loss to san francisco the cardinals used a top three pick on love in april believing he could add a dynamic game changing weapon to the backfield a la bijan robinson in atlanta or jahmyr gibbs in detroit love hasn t been healthy enough for most of the season to know for sure if he has that kind of sustainable upside arizona gave love a significant workload in his first preseason action handing it off 11 times and tossing him three passes the belief at the time was that getting reps early would prepare love for the regular season gauntlet instead he left that game with a nicked up ankle he hasn t seemed right since perhaps shutting the rb down for at least four games will allow him to come back fully healthy for the season s stretch run in the meantime tyler allgeier who sparked the cardinals comeback win over the cowboys figures to get the bulk of the totes fellow back bam knight currently is in the league s concussion protocol and veteran james conner remains on injured reserve evan hull is currently the healthy backup option for allgeier

material_news_signals.description: The free-falling Philadelphia Eagles are making a quarterback change in hopes of jumpstarting a flailing offense.
material_news_signals.body_text: the free falling philadelphia eagles are making a quarterback change in hopes of jumpstarting a flailing offense the eagles are naming joe milton as their starting qb and benching tanner mckee for sunday s game versus the new york giants nfl network s mike garafolo and espn s adam schefter reported the eagles signed milton off the dallas cowboys practice squad on oct 16 after starter jalen hurts went on injured reserve due to blood clots a 2024 sixth round pick by the new england patriots milton has appeared in five games in his career all as a reserve while he wasn t the official starter in week 18 of his rookie campaign with the patriots he played the bulk of the tilt completing 22 of 29 passes for 241 yards and a touchdown and ran for another score last year in dallas he subbed in four tilts completing 15 of 24 passes for 183 yards with a td and two ints and rushing for 50 yards on five carries an enticing athlete milton brings a completely different style from mckee milton s ability to use his legs should help an offense that has struggled to block and suffered far too many stalled drives the strong armed 26 year old can hunt big plays which also can get him into trouble he ll get a shot to prove he can evolve with more seasoning in philly the eagles bench mckee after three starts all losses he completed 72 of 114 passes for 638 yards and two tds with two ints in sunday s loss to washington the eagles couldn t find consistent offense under mckee after the first quarter and a 10 0 lead turned into a 27 10 loss mckee lost the preseason backup battle to andy dalton and entered the season as qb3 however after dalton s one wayward interception against the bears in week 3 while hurts was getting checked for a concussion philly moved on from dalton who eventually signed in atlanta now the eagles are on to qb4 with sixth straight losses philly s season feels all but over for nick sirianni s club it doesn t hurt to see what an athlete like milton could provide things can t get much worse and milton at least provides the upside to make the offense exciting once in a while

famer jim kelly on the all time bills passing touchdowns list allen retains the top spot in my rankings because he consistently produces at an elite level caleb williams continues to execute ben johnson s offense at a high rate of excellence appearing completely comfortable and capable of accomplishing whatever madness his coach draws up for the offense monday night s win over the seahawks included a direct snap to d andre swift and jet toss to williams who calmly received the toss turned and fired a strike to rome odunze as if they d done it 1 000 times before i ll continue to say it if williams keeps this up he ll be in the mvp race and the bears will be in the super bowl discussion joe burrow lit up tennessee for 462 passing yards and six total touchdowns but he threw three interceptions that gave the titans additional chances to pull off the upset in fact burrow was tasked with leading the bengals back from a fourth quarter deficit before finishing off the win in overtime you ll take the bad with the good when your quarterback is propelling such an explosive offense i suppose detroit s win over minnesota carries more weight than the average victory because of the defense the lions defeated and the fashion in which they did it jared goff was central to the fourth quarter comeback effort leading an excellent go ahead touchdown drive against an elite opponent they keep finding ways to deliver in the clutch thanks in part to goff and jahmyr gibbs of course brock purdy was uncharacteristically sloppy with the football in his most recent outing which finished with san francisco s first loss of 2026 if he can get mike evans back soon i expect those mistakes to decrease like purdy c j stroud spent the week resting thanks to the bye he s been better than his team s 2 5 record suggests but he ll need to maintain his level of performance to keep his place in tier 1 and give the texans a chance of climbing out of the hole they ve dug for themselves next gen kind of bounce back game he needed after the jaguars disappointing week 6 loss he s largely been consistent and i expect nothing less going forward drake maye and the patriots woke up in the second half of their win over the dolphins complete with maye taking a speed option keeper for a rushing score he s so fun to watch especially when he breaks out of early game struggles jordan love s deep shots to matthew golden and christian watson are becoming part of our weekly football viewing ritual and they ve never looked prettier love has cut down on mistakes and is carrying the offense which still lacks a running game like love kirk cousins is largely carrying his offense i m not sure what it means for his future but we can quell those calls for fernando mendoza for a bit cousins continues to be the reason the raiders can score in bunches patrick mahomes was on his game during a key second half stretch of sunday s loss to denver converting crucial third downs to sustain a touchdown drive that was especially impressive when considering kenneth walker was a minimal factor for a second straight week kansas city s inability to convert in a goal to go situation with the game on the line was disheartening but i m still encouraged by how mahomes bounced back after a dreadful week 7 showing next gen stats insights via nfl pro jordan love completed 30 of 41 passes for 288 yards with three touchdowns and an interception against the panthers last week love completed 23 of 25 passes thrown in under 2 5 seconds for 177 yards and two touchdowns the most quick completions by any quarterback in a game this season and the most of his career previous high 19 in week 7 of 2024 tier 3 dak prescott played a part in dallas disintegration on sunday he s being asked to carry an offense that too often can t count on legitimate contributions from the running game jerry jones said this week that george pickens should be seeing more targets so have fun interception thrown out of desperation against the raiders he s largely done enough to keep new york competitive but his successes will likely be lost in the greater picture unless of course one chooses to closely examine the weekly performances of adonai mitchell or omar cooper the rams have a problem with remarkably flat starts they re finding ways to get the job done but matthew stafford posted a pedestrian stat line in los angeles second straight win 17 of 25 for 157 yards td int they re far from the offense they need to be and that includes stafford who hasn t looked all that comfortable in sean mcvay s offense for most of the season yes i ll go out on a limb and propel cam ward up the index aggressively after the best performance of his career time will tell whether it was a sign of things to come but on sunday ward looked the part of a former no 1 overall pick he was excellent composed sharp and convicted in his decision making pushing the titans close to a huge upset before a brutal sack knocked them well out of field goal range late in the fourth quarter titans fans should feel encouraged by what they saw from ward though and acknowledge it s another building block laid along the young signal caller s nfl journey aaron rodgers didn t need to do much for the steelers in their win over the browns but he remains the savvy veteran who can quickly identify a weakness in a defensive coverage and exploit it i m still curious to see what happens if the steelers genuinely need him to go win a game for them though next gen stats insights via nfl pro produced a desperately needed touchdown for the seahawks before halftime against the bears but unless darnold morphs into a superhero quarterback he s going to continue to show some warts it s just who he is editor s update darnold has been ruled out for week 9 with a quad injury he suffered in monday night s game jayden daniels output isn t astronomical by any means but he does add an element of unpredictability that allows the commanders to sustain a competitive offensive attack he s also good for a few deep strikes per game even without terry mclaurin bryce young bounced back respectably process a bit to move closer toward the standout he was early in the season box score scanners will point to another 300 yard outing for deshaun watson and wonder how he s landed among the likes of tyler shough and j j mccarthy they ll point to his eight sacks in sunday s loss and blame his offensive line what they ll fail to recognize is how watson is running himself into pressure with unnecessarily elongated deep drops out of shotgun how his tendency to hold onto the ball becomes a problem against aggressive pass rushes and how his early fumble put the browns at a disadvantage in a hostile setting in pittsburgh is it time to press the panic button no but watson s ceiling is still pretty visible and sunday served as a reminder of it bo nix is still incredibly conservative with good which is remarkably good and bad is strikingly wide that means his ranking will remain volatile until he can prove he can be a consistent quarterback what is there to say about lamar jackson he material_news_signals.headline: Colts' Shane Steichen to 'evaluate everything, every position' after embarrassing loss in Jacksonville
material_news_signals.description: The Indianapolis Colts lost their fourth straight game, this one in embarrassing fashion in a 42-7 loss in Jacksonville.
material_news_signals.body_text: it s getting dark early in indianapolis the colts suffered another embarrassing loss on sunday getting their doors blown off 42 7 by rival jacksonville already amid a teardown it s the type of loss that puts more jobs in question coach shane steichen sits in the crosshairs after indy already parted ways with general manager chris ballard and traded away quenton nelson and deforest buckner it s one thing to be 2 6 it s a different matter to get walloped by a rival in disheartening fashion for a fourth straight loss it wasn t good enough flat out wasn t good enough steichen said via the indianapolis star we got outcoached we got outplayed and we ve got to freaking learn from our mistakes in a hurry the effort and the energy has to be there every week if not you re going to get beat like that the colts played like a team whose players know there is no coming back this season missed tackles botched offensive plays leading to turnovers ineffective quarterback play questionable play calls everything was a mess those issues fall squarely on steichen clearly i ve got to do a better job plain and simple steichen said it starts with me as the head coach i ve got to do a better job to get these guys ready to go that wasn t it today the question is how much longer steichen is the head coach clearly he couldn t get his players ready for a division
